windowReason: Common three-year warm-up for the preregistered low-volatility method; older available years remain warm-up, never called unseen.

signals.cluster: formation calendar month; descriptive t and Newey-West monthly HAC with five lags; overlapping windows not independent

cohortAccounting.monthlyWeightConvention: equal capital across active slices and fixed equal target weights within slice, reweighted at monthly next open
cohortAccounting.fidelity: VU_FORMALIZATION of source overlapping cohorts; implementation does not assert exact unrebalanced source position accounting

scoreRubric.signal: positive 63-session month-cluster HAC t>=2 and median excess>0:100; positive mean/median excess:65; neutral:40; negative:15; insufficient:0
scoreRubric.portfolio: CAGR vs SPY above 1pp and Sharpe above SPY:100; above CAGR only:75; similar within1pp:50; below:20
scoreRubric.robustness: fraction of sufficiently populated early/late/trend/vol signal segments with positive mean, scaled0..100
scoreRubric.risk: drawdown >=5pp shallower and Sharpe>=SPY:100; shallower only:70; similar within5pp:50; deeper:20
scoreRubric.fidelity: source-defined systematic long-sleeve adaptation:75; substantially formalized legendary daily-equity adaptation:45
scoreRubric.data: PIT listings and canonical prices with terminal scenario uncertainty:65; missing required PIT fundamentals:0
scoreRubric.distinctiveness: source universe preliminary assessment frozen per method; no performance-dependent changes

tierGate.A: score>=75, confidence>=MEDIUM, positive signal, portfolio ABOVE, early+late positive, terminal/cost sensitivities pass, adversarial review passes
tierGate.B: score>=55, confidence>=MEDIUM, neither signal nor portfolio materially negative; or source-defined risk specialist with positive risk evidence and adequate comparisons
tierGate.C: executable but experimental, incomplete fidelity, weak evidence or LOW confidence
tierGate.D: not mechanically admitted; educational or data blocked

dataRights.public: source metadata, rulebooks, enums and counts only
dataRights.private: all provider-derived prices, numerical performance/exposure metrics, current candidate identities and diagnostics
dataRights.results: RSA-OAEP-256+A256GCM+gzip encrypted for owner and ephemeral research session
